get.summary: Read deduplicated budget totals and paged experiment ledger rows for one TestRun

parameters.name: afterCursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor for keyset pagination; mutually exclusive with nonzero offset.

parameters.name: x-stockquant-service-id
parameters.description: Optional identity consistency check; Bearer establishes identity.

200.description: Deduplicated budget rows with keyset pagination; exact TestRun totals are computed on the first page and cursor pages return totals=null to avoid rescanning the full run. stageBudgetControl identifies whether TestRun and per-round caps are enforced; this is not provider invoice reconciliation.
